# TrackFlow Pricing Proposal RFP — ModaViva (formal)

Client: ModaViva
Country of origin: Spain
Submission deadline: 2026-10-01
Reference budget: EUR 120,000/year

Requested services:
- Warehousing in Zaragoza
- Reverse logistics / returns processing
- Client uses own carrier for last mile (not in scope)

Estimated volume: 2,800 orders/month

## Warehouse Operations

ModaViva requires pallet storage for seasonal fashion inventory in Zaragoza.
Storage capacity must support inbound peaks during collection launches.
Onboarding time target: 3 weeks from contract signature.

## Reverse Logistics

Returns processing for Spain e-commerce orders with inspection and restocking.
Returns turnaround expectations should follow TrackFlow standard operations.
